threat_event: A script placed on the website event pages draws a fake payment form over the checkout widget and skims card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared website administrator login with no MFA; 6 unmanaged third-party scripts on event pages; no change detection
regulatory_driver: N71-R04 (6.4.3; 11.6.1; SAQ A eligibility); Fla. Stat. 501.171
existing_controls: Checkout widget code is the vendor's (vendor AOC); TLS
treatment_plan: Named website logins with MFA; remove scripts not needed on event pages; weekly page check and website change alerts; quarterly ASV scans

threat_event: Takeover of a ticketing platform account, followed by a patron export, fraudulent refunds, or setting changes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 venue accounts with local passwords and no MFA; shared 'door' login; marketing role can export all patrons; no log review
existing_controls: Role-based permissions in the platform
treatment_plan: Enforce MFA for all venue users; named door logins; remove export rights from the marketing role; weekly check of exports and refunds

threat_event: Malware on the back-office PC captures card numbers typed for phone orders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Back-office PC also used for email, browsing, and bookkeeping; on the staff Wi-Fi with touring crews; signature anti-malware only
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 back-office PC; MID-T phone orders
existing_controls: MSP anti-malware and patching
treatment_plan: Stop taking card numbers by phone; send callers a purchase link or help them buy online; first put accessible tickets on sale online

threat_event: Card numbers kept in the shared box office mailbox are exposed through a mailbox takeover
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Patrons and renters email card details; 23 such emails since 2023 (9 with security codes); shared mailbox password and no MFA
existing_controls: Suite MFA on named accounts
treatment_plan: Emails purged by the MSP on 2026-08-03; auto-reply and website notice: never email card numbers; delete any that arrive; shared mailboxes reached only through named accounts

threat_event: The 2026 PCI DSS validation fails or is filed wrongly, leading to fees, higher processing rates, or loss of the ticketing merchant account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Never validated; no documented scope; portal pre-selected SAQ A for a channel mix it does not fit
existing_controls: Acquirer letter sets the path
treatment_plan: Scope decision (P03 Option B) by 2026-09-30; evidence for every SAQ answer; ASV scans; SAQs and AOCs filed by 2026-12-15

threat_event: A former employee or contractor uses a still-active ticketing or website login
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No offboarding checklist; former Marketing Coordinator's account active 4 months (disabled 2026-07-21); shared passwords never changed
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Last-day checklist for ticketing, website, suite, and Wi-Fi; change shared passwords when anyone leaves; monthly account check

threat_event: Fraudulent refunds or complimentary tickets issued under the shared 'door' login
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared login with refund rights; no refund report review
existing_controls: Box Office and Ticketing Manager reconciles door cash
treatment_plan: Named door logins without refund rights; weekly refund report check

threat_event: Ransomware on the office computers encrypts the back-office PC and synced settlement workbooks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing training; signature anti-malware only; alerts only in business hours; backup never restore-tested
existing_controls: MSP patching and anti-malware; suite MFA
treatment_plan: MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alerting; training and phishing simulations; restore tests

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects an artist settlement payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payment instructions arrive by email; no callback check; no phishing training
existing_controls: Suite MFA on named accounts; Owner approves each payment
treatment_plan: Callback to a known number before any new or changed bank details; training for the Owner and Bookkeeper

threat_event: A touring crew member or former staff on the staff Wi-Fi reaches the back-office PC or door tablets
threat_source: Untrusted device on the staff network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One flat staff Wi-Fi; password posted in the green room since 2023
existing_controls: Guest Wi-Fi for patrons is separate
treatment_plan: Separate staff network for office computers and door tablets; crew Wi-Fi with internet only; new passwords each season

threat_event: A tampered or swapped P2PE card reader at the door or bar captures card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No reader inventory with serial numbers; no inspections; spare door reader found in an unlocked drawer
existing_controls: Readers are attended during shows; CCTV covers the door box office and bar
treatment_plan: Inventory with serial numbers; pre-show inspection by the door and bar leads; spare reader locked in the safe (done 2026-07-22)

threat_event: Settlement workbooks or shared mailbox records cannot be restored after deletion or ransomware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup excludes the 2 shared mailboxes; never restore-tested; one MSP login without MFA can delete backups
existing_controls: Daily backup of named mailboxes and shared files
treatment_plan: Add shared mailboxes; MFA on the backup console; first restore test 2026-09-30 and then quarterly

threat_event: A lost or stolen laptop exposes patron exports
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner's laptop not encrypted; patron exports kept on laptops indefinitely
existing_controls: 4 of 5 office computers encrypted
treatment_plan: Encrypt the Owner's laptop; delete exports after use; exports only to the restricted suite folder

threat_event: Advertised ticket prices omit the mandatory fees (FTC fee rule violation)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Website listings, emails, and social posts show the base price only; no pre-publication check
existing_controls: Checkout widget shows the total and final amount before payment
treatment_plan: Total price in every price display; pre-publication checklist; correct fee labels

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP or its remote tool reaches every office computer and the suite
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP tool can run commands on all computers; MFA for technicians not evidenced; no incident notice or recovery terms in the MSP contract
existing_controls: MSP contract with 4-business-hour response
treatment_plan: Yearly MSP security questions and evidence; contract amendment for 24-hour incident notice, named technicians with MFA, and a recovery time

threat_event: Bot screening blocks legitimate patrons with no appeal, unevenly across patron groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No review of blocks; no appeal route; audio challenge alternative off
existing_controls: Box office phone line open during on-sales
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: appeal route, release log, audio alternative, review after each protected on-sale

threat_event: Accepted price recommendations break artist price caps or charge more for accessible tickets
threat_source: Box Office and Ticketing Manager with vendor recommendations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No floors or ceilings entered; accessible tickets priced as a separate tier the tool can raise; no review
existing_controls: Each recommendation needs a click to accept
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: caps entered as ceilings; accessible tiers excluded and checked for parity; Owner review of changes over 20%

threat_event: Brokers' bots get around the 4-ticket limit during a sold-out on-sale
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Limit enforced per account only
existing_controls: Vendor bot screening and on-sale queue
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low: about 6 high-demand on-sales a year; rely on the vendor screening; keep block records for any referral (P10)

threat_event: Internet outage on a show night stops bar card sales, door sales, and scanner syncing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One internet line; no failover
existing_controls: Scanners work offline from a manifest; cash fallback
treatment_plan: Cellular failover router; manifest download on the pre-show checklist

threat_event: Scanner or ticketing failure at doors causes a long line and crowd pressure outside
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written manual door procedure
existing_controls: Offline scanner mode; security guards at the door
treatment_plan: Manual door procedure (printed door list, wristbands); drill before the fall season

threat_event: Breach notices to the acquirer, Visa, patrons, or Florida are missed or late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident response plan; staff unaware of the 24-hour acquirer term and card brand timelines
existing_controls: Cyber insurance breach hotline
treatment_plan: POL-03 and the P08 runbook; tabletop with the MSP and insurer hotline

threat_event: A breach at the ticketing vendor or payment partner exposes patron or card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Company depends on vendor controls; no breach notice term in the ticketing contract
existing_controls: Vendor AOC and SOC 2 report; Florida third-party agent duty
treatment_plan: Yearly AOC and SOC 2 review; 72-hour notice term at renewal; cyber insurance covers notification costs

threat_event: Patron records synced to a lapsed email marketing account are reached by an unauthorized party
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2024 API token with patron read access never revoked; nightly sync to an account at a vendor with no current contract
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 API; former email marketing service
existing_controls: None until found
treatment_plan: Token revoked 2026-08-12; written deletion confirmation from the former service; API token list in the monthly account check
